lenses.label: ESO VISTA · infrared
lenses.title: Helix in near infrared
lenses.description: Source-colored relative emission fitted to aligned ESO images with a molecular-velocity scaffold where measured. Unsupported depth and the front/back assignment remain conditional. Compact lights have observed image positions, with illustrative field depths. The reference image shows the photograph before star removal and 3D color fitting. Surrounding optical stars use Gaia positions and parallax-informed distances; their brightness/color display is independent of this spectral image.
lenses.summary: Near-infrared false color on a partly velocity-constrained model; halo and bright-core depths remain inferred.
